cases.name: form-action
cases.request: Add a CSS-only common button named Preview preferences inside form#preferences. It must not submit the form. Preserve the existing save behavior and accessible markup. Do not add JavaScript for this action.

cases.name: brand-token
cases.request: Change the existing ExpressiveCSS brand seed to #6750a4 through the semantic theming system. This is token-only work: preserve HTML, layout, content, and JavaScript.

cases.name: tooltip-remount
cases.request: Repair the Privacy help tooltip. Initialize #account-help manually with Expressive.Tooltip, destroy its old instance before #remount-help replaces the host, initialize the replacement, and clean up when the page is left. Preserve AutoInit ownership for other controls and prevent duplicate tooltip instances.

cases.name: no-edit-audit
cases.request: Audit this account dashboard without editing any files. Check the new icon-only action and whether the Save command belongs in its navigation landmark. Report the actual accessibility and semantics defects with source locations and fixes. Separate source findings from browser observations and unavailable checks.

cases.name: navigation-media
cases.request: Refine this account dashboard's responsive navigation and hero image loading. The bar and rail currently overlap at wide widths, and the prominent hero has no dimensions and is lazy-loaded. Show exactly one peer navigation at Compact and Expanded widths, preserve all three destinations and existing identity/content/actions, reserve the hero's intrinsic 1200 by 600 ratio and avoid delaying its loading. Capture before/after evidence and check 839px and 840px. Keep changes limited to these defects.

cases.name: version-mismatch
cases.request: Review and repair setup only where it is safe for this project pinned to ExpressiveCSS 0.7.0. Compare the installed version with the bundled skill contract. Preserve the pinned dependency; do not upgrade or invent missing files. Only metadata for the older package is available and network documentation is unavailable in this scenario. Report the version mismatch and block any unsupported target-version claims instead of treating current website documentation as verified.
